_fixture: Demo scenarios. `simulation` flags are honoured only by the fixture merchants/suppliers and are recorded on the request so every injected failure is visible in the timeline.

A.title: Constraint-aware selection (deadline beats price)
A.text: Buy 10 monitors, at least 27 inch, total ≤ $2,000 including delivery, delivered to HQ before Friday, charge IT Hardware
A.expect: supplier_a (merchant_a, UCP) is cheaper but its 9-day freight misses Friday; supplier_b (merchant_b, ACP) at $1,900 delivered is selected. Merchant_a's quote is shown as ineligible with the failed constraint.

B.title: Changed checkout invalidates approval
B.text: Buy 10 monitors, at least 27 inch, total ≤ $2,000 including delivery, delivered to HQ before Friday, charge IT Hardware
B.expect: After approval, merchant_b raises shipping by $25. Execution re-reads the checkout, the digest no longer matches, the approval is invalidated and the request returns to awaiting_approval with a field-level diff.

C.title: Independent UCP path
C.text: Buy 10 monitors, at least 27 inch, total ≤ $2,000 including delivery, delivered to HQ within 3 weeks, charge IT Hardware
C.expect: With a later deadline merchant_a's cheaper quote ($1,708 delivered) wins and the purchase completes over UCP v2026-08-25.

D.title: Dropped completion response is recovered without buying twice
D.text: Buy 10 monitors, at least 27 inch, total ≤ $2,000 including delivery, delivered to HQ before Friday, charge IT Hardware
D.expect: merchant_b accepts the order but never returns the completion response. The attempt lands in outcome_unknown; the recovery worker reads the native checkout, finds the order and records exactly one purchase.
